materials.name: Ravda Mint
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Ravda meadows, riverbanks. When: Spring–Autumn; Morning; after light rain. How to harvest: Snip upper leaves; keep the root crown intact. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Restorative cooling leaf. Failure / hazard: Strong scent can reveal a hidden forager. Current crafting use: Potion of Healing; Herbal Healing Draught; Potion of Greater Healing; Potion of Fleetstep; Potion of Blooming Vitality; +1 more.
Often carried by village healers

materials.name: Clearwater Moss
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Streams and wet stones. When: All year if unfrozen; Daylight near clean running water. How to harvest: Lift only loose tufts from wet stone; leave a patch for regrowth. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Clean water and purification. Failure / hazard: Silts the water if stripped too quickly. Current crafting use: Potion of Healing; Antitoxin; Acid Vial; Azure Spell Salt; Potion of Gender Change; +7 more.
Grows near unpolluted springs

materials.name: Briarwort
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Velorian woodland hedges. When: Spring–Autumn; Dry weather. How to harvest: Clip tender shoots using thick gloves; avoid the thorny heart. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Resilience against natural toxins. Failure / hazard: Thorns may cause 1 piercing damage on failure by 5+. Current crafting use: Antitoxin; Acid Vial; Alchemist’s Fire; Black Iron Guard Resin; Bloodbound Tonic; +9 more.
Collected with thick gloves

materials.name: Emberleaf
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Sunny rocky slopes. When: Summer; Late morning. How to harvest: Harvest the unburned red-tipped leaves before midday heat. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Warmth and controlled flame. Failure / hazard: Warm sap may deal 1 fire damage on failure by 5+. Current crafting use: Acid Vial; Alchemist’s Fire; Stormcharge Oil; Abyssal Ember Flask; Potion of Emberblood; +4 more.
Crinkles when rubbed between fingers

materials.name: Stonebark Thyme
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Stony hills and old walls. When: Spring–Summer; After sunrise. How to harvest: Cut woody sprigs; do not pull from the cracks. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Stability and endurance. Failure / hazard: Loose stones can make noise on a bad attempt. Current crafting use: Alchemist’s Fire; Black Iron Guard Resin; Potion of Emberblood; Potion of Stoneflesh; Potion of Iron Nerves; +3 more.
Tough, silver-dusted stems

materials.name: Stormsage
materials.description:
Uncommon | Search DC 13 | Harvest DC 13 | Yield 1d3 units

Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Static electricity and quick reflexes. Failure / hazard: 1 lightning damage on failure by 5+. Current crafting use: Stormcharge Oil; Potion of Stormguard; Potion of Thunder Voice; Potion of Spellspark; Rune of Thunder; +1 more.
Only mature after severe thunderstorms

Petals close at noon

Pale violet with silver veins

materials.description:
Rare | Search DC 16 | Harvest DC 16 | Yield 1 unit per suitable source (GM may allow 1d2 from a large specimen)
Where: Shadowfell trails near Kozunak. When: All year; After a safe encounter, found shed. How to harvest: Collect a discarded claw sheath with a covered hook Suggested tools: Survival. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Shadow camouflage and binding rites; a confirmed alchemical reagent in Averis Crafting v1.4 Failure / hazard: Failure by 5+: strange distant howls alert nearby creatures Current crafting use: Void Seeker Dust; Potion of Shadowfade
The sheath leaves no scratch in wax.

materials.name: Fey Stag Tail Hair
materials.description:
Rare | Search DC 16 | Harvest DC 16 | Yield 1 unit per suitable source (GM may allow 1d2 from a large specimen)
Where: Feywild glades. When: Spring–Summer; After a stag has willingly passed. How to harvest: Gather hair from branches; never cut from an unwilling Fey beast Suggested tools: Survival. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Grace enchantments and nature bindings; a confirmed alchemical reagent in Averis Crafting v1.4 Failure / hazard: Uninvited hunters may draw Fey disfavor Current crafting use: Potion of Phase Step
The fibres refuse to knot if taken by force.

materials.name: Wyvern Venom Gland
materials.description:
Rare | Search DC 16 | Harvest DC 16 | Yield 1 unit per suitable source (GM may allow 1d2 from a large specimen)
Where: Cliff nests and remains of slain wyverns. When: All year; Within one hour of a slain wyvern. How to harvest: Carefully extract intact venom sac with sealed gloves Suggested tools: Poisoner's Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: GM-controlled fantasy toxin research and professionally purified alchemy reagent; never used raw Failure / hazard: Failure by 5+: DC 13 Constitution save or Poisoned for 10 minutes Current crafting use: Bloodbound Tonic; Abyssal Ember Flask; Potion of Abyssal Fury
Amber venom burns a pinhole in cloth.

materials.name: Dragon Shed Scale
materials.description:
Very Rare | Search DC 19 | Harvest DC 19 | Yield 1 unit, GM-controlled discovery
Where: An ancient dragon's old territory. When: Exceptional; Only when a shed scale can be found. How to harvest: Lift a naturally fallen scale from its resting place Suggested tools: Leatherworker's Tools. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Great protective rites and legendary crafting; a confirmed alchemical reagent in Averis Crafting v1.4 Failure / hazard: A dragon may regard collection as trespass; GM permission required Current crafting use: Heartstone Guardian Serum; Potion of Supreme Healing; Potion of Heartkeeper
The scale retains a memory of the dragon's colour.

materials.name: Coastal Kelp
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Shallow waters around Coralspire. When: Spring–Autumn; Low tide. How to harvest: Cut long kelp blades above their holdfasts Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Waterproof dressing and seafaring gear. Failure / hazard: Failure tangles fishing lines and equipment Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Sea-green strands dry into flexible sheets.

materials.name: Seafoam Algae
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Coralspire tide pools. When: All year; Just after waves retreat. How to harvest: Skim the surface film using a fine net Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Cleansing ink and ritual water filtration. Failure / hazard: Surface film spoils in direct heat Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Foams a second time when placed in pure water.

materials.name: Tidepool Brine Salt
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Salt pans and sheltered coastal rock pools. When: Summer; After sunny days. How to harvest: Evaporate collected brine and sieve the dry grains Suggested tools: Alchemist's Supplies. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Preservation, seals and nonmagical solvent for rune pigments. Failure / hazard: Poor filtration leaves sand that weakens the batch Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Pale crystals that are salt, not an ore.

materials.name: Siren Shell Fragment
materials.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Beaches and river mouths near merfolk routes. When: All year; After storms. How to harvest: Pick up empty broken shells; do not disturb inhabited shells Suggested tools: Survival. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Sound charms and jewelry. Failure / hazard: Handling occupied shells angers local wildlife Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Holds a quiet resonance of the tide.

materials.name: Glowfin Slime
materials.description:
Uncommon | Search DC 13 | Harvest DC 13 | Yield 1d3 units
Where: Deep freshwater pools and dark river bends. When: Spring–Autumn; Night. How to harvest: Collect residue left on submerged stones, not from live fish Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Subtle illumination and tracking dye. Failure / hazard: Touching eyes causes harmless bright afterimages Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
A drop paints faint lines through water.

materials.name: Deepreef Anemone Thread
materials.description:
Uncommon | Search DC 13 | Harvest DC 13 | Yield 1d3 units
Where: Reef edges offshore of Coralspire. When: Summer; Calm seas. How to harvest: Clip an outer thread without tearing the anemone Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Gripping adhesive and aquatic gear wraps. Failure / hazard: Failure by 5+: 1 poison damage from stinging tentacles Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
The thread curls toward passing currents.

materials.name: Moonpool Water
materials.description:
Uncommon | Search DC 13 | Harvest DC 13 | Yield 1d3 units
Where: Feywild pools and secluded moonlit springs. When: Spring–Autumn; Full moon. How to harvest: Fill a covered vial without breaking the surface with metal Suggested tools: Alchemist's Supplies. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Moon rune ink and purification ceremonies. Failure / hazard: Water loses resonance if exposed to sunlight before sealing Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Reflects a different phase of the moon.

materials.name: Feydew Droplet
materials.description:
Uncommon | Search DC 13 | Harvest DC 13 | Yield 1d3 units
Where: Feywild flowers and leaves. When: Spring–Summer; Dawn. How to harvest: Collect single large droplets with glass pipette Suggested tools: Alchemist's Supplies. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Transmutation sigils and enchanted perfumes. Failure / hazard: Dew evaporates if touched by iron Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Each droplet reflects a different season.

materials.name: Starfall Dew
materials.description:
Rare | Search DC 16 | Harvest DC 16 | Yield 1d2 units
Where: Clear highland meadows in Ashenfall. When: Autumn; Before sunrise after a meteor shower. How to harvest: Catch dew on white cloth and squeeze into a sealed vial Suggested tools: Alchemist's Supplies. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Vision/focus rune ink and celestial inscriptions. Failure / hazard: One failed attempt consumes the delicate collection window Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
The liquid glints with pinpoints of light.

materials.name: Shadowfell Condensation
materials.description:
Rare | Search DC 16 | Harvest DC 16 | Yield 1d2 units
Where: Cold stone around Kozunak planar seams. When: All year; During heavy shadow mist. How to harvest: Collect beads on black glass; never breathe the mist directly Suggested tools: Alchemist's Supplies. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Shadow ritual ink and occult inscription. Failure / hazard: Failure by 5+: dim light appears darker for 10 minutes (cosmetic) Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
Frost beads gather on the shadow side of stone.

materials.name: Ethereal Mist Droplet
materials.description:
Rare | Search DC 16 | Harvest DC 16 | Yield 1d2 units
Where: Thin places near the Ethereal barrier. When: Exceptional; At a local veil fluctuation. How to harvest: Hold a stoppered glass vial through a cold stream of mist Suggested tools: Alchemist's Supplies. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Intangibility-themed experiments and spectral ink. Failure / hazard: Failure causes mist to disperse with no effect Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
A silver bead floats just above the vial floor.

materials.name: Planar Veil Thread
materials.description:
Very Rare | Search DC 19 | Harvest DC 19 | Yield 1 unit, GM-controlled discovery
Where: Sites where two planes briefly overlap. When: Exceptional; After a major barrier disturbance. How to harvest: Wind one strand around a wooden spindle; never pull on the rift Suggested tools: Arcana. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Powerful rune catalyst and barrier lore. Failure / hazard: Restricted GM material; failure ends the encounter window Current crafting use: No mandatory recipe in Crafting v1.3; optional new material for experiments.
For an instant, the thread casts four shadows.

resources.name: Copper Ore
resources.description: Gadgets, fittings, locks and mechanisms. No magic effect.

resources.description: A weapon specifically crafted as silvered counts as silvered for creature traits that mention silver.

resources.name: Gold Ore
resources.description: Fine jewelry and channeling components; no standalone numerical benefit.

resources.name: Black Iron
resources.description: Weapon: +1 damage against objects and constructs . Defensive item: 1/long rest, reaction to reduce incoming bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage by 1d4.

resources.name: Azure Crystal
resources.description: Focus: 1/long rest, add 1d4 to one spell attack roll after rolling, before the GM announces the outcome.

resources.name: Storm Ore
resources.description: Weapon: 1/long rest, on a hit +1d4 lightning damage. Shield: 1/long rest, reaction when hit by a melee attack, deal 1d4 lightning to that attacker within 5 ft. Gadget: 1/long rest, action to create a harmless spark or signal up to 30 ft.

resources.name: Void Shard
resources.description: Weapon: 1/long rest, immediately after a hit, teleport up to 5 ft into visible unoccupied space. Accessory: 1/long rest, action to sense direction of nearest active portal within 60 ft, if any.

resources.name: Blood Ore
resources.description: Weapon: 1/long rest, on hit lose 1d4 HP for +1d6 necrotic damage. Accessory: 1/long rest, bonus action lose 1d4 HP to gain 1d6 temporary HP for 1 hour.

resources.name: Abyssal Ore
resources.description: Weapon: 1/long rest, on a hit deal +1d6 fire or necrotic (chosen on creation). Shield: 1/long rest, reaction when hit, deal 1d6 necrotic to an attacker within 5 ft.

resources.name: Heartstone
resources.description: Attuned accessory: 1/long rest, when the wearer would drop to 0 HP without being killed outright, they drop to 1 HP instead.

resources.name: Eclipse Ore
resources.description: Attuned weapon: 1/long rest, on a hit +2d6 radiant or necrotic. Attuned focus: 1/long rest, when a spell damages a target, deal +2d6 to one such target. Choose damage type at the end of a long rest.

resources.name: Ravda Mint
resources.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Ravda meadows, riverbanks. When: Spring–Autumn; Morning; after light rain. How to harvest: Snip upper leaves; keep the root crown intact. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Restorative cooling leaf. Failure / hazard: Strong scent can reveal a hidden forager. Current crafting use: Potion of Healing; Herbal Healing Draught; Potion of Greater Healing; Potion of Fleetstep; Potion of Blooming Vitality; +1 more.
Often carried by village healers

resources.name: Clearwater Moss
resources.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Streams and wet stones. When: All year if unfrozen; Daylight near clean running water. How to harvest: Lift only loose tufts from wet stone; leave a patch for regrowth. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Clean water and purification. Failure / hazard: Silts the water if stripped too quickly. Current crafting use: Potion of Healing; Antitoxin; Acid Vial; Azure Spell Salt; Potion of Gender Change; +7 more.
Grows near unpolluted springs
resources.when: All year if unfrozen; Daylight near clean running water.

resources.name: Briarwort
resources.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Velorian woodland hedges. When: Spring–Autumn; Dry weather. How to harvest: Clip tender shoots using thick gloves; avoid the thorny heart. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Resilience against natural toxins. Failure / hazard: Thorns may cause 1 piercing damage on failure by 5+. Current crafting use: Antitoxin; Acid Vial; Alchemist’s Fire; Black Iron Guard Resin; Bloodbound Tonic; +9 more.
Collected with thick gloves

resources.name: Emberleaf
resources.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Sunny rocky slopes. When: Summer; Late morning. How to harvest: Harvest the unburned red-tipped leaves before midday heat. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Warmth and controlled flame. Failure / hazard: Warm sap may deal 1 fire damage on failure by 5+. Current crafting use: Acid Vial; Alchemist’s Fire; Stormcharge Oil; Abyssal Ember Flask; Potion of Emberblood; +4 more.
Crinkles when rubbed between fingers

resources.name: Stonebark Thyme
resources.description:
Common | Search DC 10 | Harvest DC 10 | Yield 1d4 units
Where: Stony hills and old walls. When: Spring–Summer; After sunrise. How to harvest: Cut woody sprigs; do not pull from the cracks. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Stability and endurance. Failure / hazard: Loose stones can make noise on a bad attempt. Current crafting use: Alchemist’s Fire; Black Iron Guard Resin; Potion of Emberblood; Potion of Stoneflesh; Potion of Iron Nerves; +3 more.
Tough, silver-dusted stems

resources.name: Stormsage
resources.description:
Uncommon | Search DC 13 | Harvest DC 13 | Yield 1d3 units
Where: Ashenfall highlands, storm ridges. When: Spring–Autumn; Within 24 hours of a thunderstorm. How to harvest: Wear dry gloves and cut only the charged purple leaf tips. Suggested tools: Herbalism Kit. (A relevant proficiency applies once.) Use: Static electricity and quick reflexes. Failure / hazard: 1 lightning damage on failure by 5+.
